item.title: How to use Angular with Vite
item.description: Integrating Vite into the Angular ecosystem has transformed the developer experience by drastically reducing startup times and enhancing Hot Module Replacement (HMR) performance. As the creator of CoreUI, I have closely followed the evolution of build tools from early Gulp tasks to the modern esbuild-powered era. The most effective way to use Vite with Angular is to leverage the official @angular-devkit/build-angular:application builder, which uses Vite for the development server and esbuild for production bundles. This native integration ensures full compatibility with the Angular compiler while providing the blistering speed associated with Vite.
